correctness.rationale: Direct proof: Hermite linearization coefficient c_k(i) is a degree-k polynomial in i(s-i); high-degree separation and Vandermonde invertibility prove unordered-product independence for r>2 floor((d-1)/2). Each offdiagonal two-angle determinant is proportional to sin(r(j-i)Delta), yielding exact real nullity; integer divisibility gives rational formula. Exact symbolic checker confirms polynomial independence and 14 phase ranks for finite cases. Finite computations are only corroboration. Positive-density-matrix ambiguity follows by perturbing I/d.

value.rationale: Quantifies exact informational loss of a natural sparse oscillator state across a continuum of measurement-phase pairs. Two continuously sampled views are globally minimal for all d when ladder gaps are high enough; the exact rational denominator law measures how exceptional phases erase offdiagonal coherence. The dimension-specific result addresses a motivated tomography sampling gap. It does not claim practical finite-shot stability or gap optimality.
